cards.ex: The city's corrupt government had become a real den of thieves, with officials openly accepting bribes.
cards.exUz: Shaharning korruptsiyalashgan hukumati haqiqiy o'g'rilar uyasiga aylanib qolgan edi, amaldorlar ochiqchasiga pora olayotgan edi.
cards.uzDef: O'g'rilar va jinoyatchilar yashirinib faoliyat ko'rsatadigan joy, uyushgan jinoyatchilik markazi.

cards.ex: The company was warned that they needed to clean up their act or face prosecution for fraud.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaga firibgarlik uchun jinoiy javobgarlikka tortilmasliklari uchun o'zini tuzatish kerakligi haqida ogohlantirildi.
cards.uzDef: O'zining yomon xulq-atvori yoki noqonuniy faoliyatini to'xtatib, yaxshi tomonga o'zgarish.

cards.ex: After years of corruption, the judge decided to throw the book at the former mayor.
cards.exUz: Ko'p yillik korruptsiyadan so'ng, sudya sobiq merga eng qattiq jazoni berishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir eng qattiq jazolamoq, barcha qonuniy choralarni ko'rmoq.

cards.ex: He got off lightly with just a fine, considering the damage he caused.
cards.exUz: U keltirgan zararni hisobga olsak, u faqat jarima bilan engil qutuldi.
cards.uzDef: Jazodan osonlikcha qutulmoq, kutilganidan kamroq jazo olmoq.

cards.ex: The burglar was caught red-handed trying to break into the house.
cards.exUz: O'g'ri uyga o'g'irlik qilishga urinayotganda ustida qo'lga tushdi.
cards.uzDef: Jinoyat sodir etayotgan paytda ushlanmoq, dalillar bilan qo'lga tushmoq.

cards.ex: Even after fleeing the country, he couldn't escape the long arm of the law.
cards.exUz: Mamlakatdan qochib ketganidan keyin ham, u qonunning uzun qo'lidan qochib qutula olmadi.
cards.term: the long arm of the law
cards.uzDef: Qonun organlarining qayerda bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, jinoyatchilarni topib jazolash qobiliyati.

cards.ex: The man they arrested fit the description given by the witness perfectly.
cards.exUz: Ular hibsga olgan odam guvoh bergan ta'rifga to'liq mos tushdi.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir tashqi ko'rinishi yoki xususiyatlari berilgan ta'rifga to'g'ri kelmoq.

cards.ex: If you break the law, you have to face the consequences.
cards.exUz: Agar qonunni buzgan bo'lsangiz, oqibatlariga duch kelishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'z xatti-harakatlari uchun javobgarlikka tortilmoq, yomon natijalarga duch kelmoq.

cards.ex: The judge's biased ruling was a travesty of justice.
cards.exUz: Sudyaning xolis bo'lmagan qarori adolatni buzish edi.
cards.uzDef: Adolatning buzilishi, nohaqlik va adolatsizlikning namoyishi.

cards.ex: His reputation was above suspicion until the investigation began.
cards.exUz: Tekshiruv boshlangunga qadar uning obro'si shubhaga o'rin qoldirmas edi.
cards.uzDef: Shubhaga o'rin qoldirmaydigan, shubhali bo'lmagan.

cards.ex: After the investigation, he was finally in the clear.
cards.exUz: Tekshiruvdan so'ng, u nihoyat aybsiz deb topildi.
cards.uzDef: Aybsiz deb topilgan, xavf-xatarsiz, hech qanday muammosiz.

cards.ex: With the evidence so clear, it seemed like an open-and-shut case.
cards.exUz: Dalillar shunchalik aniq ediki, bu oson ishdek tuyuldi.
cards.uzDef: Dalillar aniq va bahsli bo'lmagan, hal qilish oson bo'lgan ish.

cards.ex: He decided to turn state's evidence to avoid a long prison sentence.
cards.exUz: U uzoq muddatli qamoq jazosidan qochish uchun davlat guvohi bo'lishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Jinoyatda qatnashgan shaxs, boshqalarga qarshi guvohlik berish evaziga jazodan qutulmoq.

cards.ex: He claimed the evidence was planted and that it was a frame-up.
cards.exUz: U dalillar soxta ekanligini va bu tuhmat ekanligini aytdi.
cards.uzDef: Birovni yolg'on ayb bilan tuhmat qilish, qonuniy muammolarga duchor qilish.

cards.ex: The victim was murdered in cold blood.
cards.exUz: Jabrlanuvchi sovuqqonlik bilan o'ldirilgan.
cards.uzDef: Rejali va shafqatsiz ravishda, his-tuyg'ularga berilmasdan sodir etilgan jinoyat.

cards.ex: The stolen jewels are now safely under lock and key.
cards.exUz: O'g'irlangan javohirlar endi xavfsiz joyda qulflangan.
cards.uzDef: Qattiq himoyalangan va qulflangan joyda, qochishning iloji yo'q.

cards.ex: He invoked his right to remain silent and refused to answer any questions.
cards.exUz: U jim turish huquqidan foydalanib, hech qanday savolga javob berishdan bosh tortdi.
cards.uzDef: Hibsdagi odamning savollarga javob bermaslik huquqi.

cards.ex: Many people believe that the punishment should fit the crime.
cards.exUz: Ko'pchilik odamlar jazo jinoyatga mos kelishi kerakligiga ishonadi.
cards.uzDef: Jazo jinoyatning og'irligiga mos kelishi kerak.

cards.ex: The investigation uncovered a clear paper trail leading to the CEO.
cards.exUz: Tekshiruv bosh direktorga olib boruvchi aniq hujjatlar izini ochib berdi.
cards.uzDef: Jinoyat yoki noqonuniy faoliyatni isbotlovchi hujjatlar to'plami.

cards.ex: The police were accused of turning a blind eye to the gang's activities.
cards.exUz: Politsiya to'daning faoliyatiga ko'z yumganlikda ayblandi.
cards.uzDef: Yomon yoki noqonuniy narsani bilib turib e'tibor bermaslik, ko'rmaslikka olmoq.

cards.ex: Some argue that certain types of drug use are victimless crimes.
cards.exUz: Ba'zilar giyohvand moddalarni iste'mol qilishning ayrim turlari jabrlanuvchisiz jinoyat deb hisoblashadi.
cards.uzDef: Hech kimga bevosita zarar keltirmaydigan jinoyat.

cards.ex: He's been under house arrest awaiting his trial.
cards.exUz: U sud jarayonini kutib, uy qamog'ida saqlanmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Sudning qarori bilan o'z uyida qamalgan, tashqariga chiqishga ruxsat yo'q.

cards.ex: No one is above the law, regardless of their position.
cards.exUz: Hech kim o'z lavozimidan qat'i nazar, qonundan yuqori emas.
cards.uzDef: Qonunlar unga ta'sir qilmaydigan, qonundan ustun bo'lgan.

cards.ex: They exploited a legal loophole to avoid paying taxes.
cards.exUz: Ular soliq to'lashdan qochish uchun huquqiy bo'shliqdan foydalanishdi.
cards.uzDef: Qonunda noaniqlik, undan foydalanib qonunni chetlab o'tish mumkin.

cards.ex: The police served a warrant at the suspect's apartment early this morning.
cards.exUz: Politsiya gumondorning kvartirasiga erta tongda order topshirdi.
cards.uzDef: Sudning orderini kimningdir uyiga yoki ish joyiga topshirish, qonuniy rasmiylashtirish.

cards.ex: He chose to plead not guilty to all charges.
cards.exUz: U barcha ayblovlar bo'yicha o'zini aybdor emas deb e'lon qilishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Sudda aybiga iqror bo'lmaslik, aybsizlikni da'vo qilish.

cards.ex: He's been on parole for the last two years.
cards.exUz: U so'nggi ikki yil davomida shartli ozodlikda bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Qamoqdan muddatidan oldin ozod qilingan, lekin nazorat ostida bo'lgan.

cards.ex: The trial ended with a hung jury, so they'll have to do it again.
cards.exUz: Sud jarayoni kelishilmagan hay'at bilan yakunlandi, shuning uchun ular buni yana qilishlari kerak.
cards.uzDef: Sud hay'ati a'zolari yakdil fikrga kelmaganligi sababli, hukm chiqara olmagan sud.

cards.ex: The company has been accused of questionable ethics in its business dealings.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya o'zining biznes aloqalarida shubhali axloqqa ega bo'lganlikda ayblanmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Axloqiy jihatdan shubhali, to'g'ri emas deb hisoblash mumkin bo'lgan xatti-harakat.

cards.ex: There was a lot of negotiation going on behind the scenes.
cards.exUz: Sahna ortida juda ko'p muzokaralar olib borilmoqda edi.
cards.uzDef: Ommaga ko'rinmaydigan, yashirincha sodir bo'layotgan.
